mapper.select: SELECT stats.name, stats.calls, stats.errorRate, stats.avgDurationNs, tech.tech, stats.q[1] AS p50, stats.q[2] AS p90, stats.q[3] AS p99 FROM ( SELECT service_name AS name, toUInt64(count()) AS calls, sumIf(1, is_error = 1) / count() AS errorRate, avg(duration_ns) AS avgDurationNs, quantiles(0.5, 0.9, 0.99)(duration_ns) AS q FROM quasar_tracing.span_service_index WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) GROUP BY service_name ) AS stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ServiceName AS name, nullIf(multiIf( positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'clickhouse') > 0, 'ClickHouse', positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'redis') > 0, 'Redis', positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'kafka') > 0, 'Kafka', positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'mysql') > 0, 'MySQL', positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'mongodb') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'mongo') > 0, 'MongoDB', positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'postgresql') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'postgres') > 0, 'PostgreSQL', positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'elasticsearch') > 0, 'Elasticsearch', positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'rabbitmq') > 0, 'RabbitMQ', positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'rocketmq') > 0, 'RocketMQ', positionCaseInsensitive(ServiceName, 'nginx') > 0, 'Nginx', countIf(positionCaseInsensitive(ScopeName, 'spring') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(ResourceAttributes['telemetry.distro.name'], 'spring') > 0 OR indexOf(mapKeys(ResourceAttributes), 'spring.application.name') > 0) > 0, 'Spring', countIf(ResourceAttributes['telemetry.sdk.language'] = 'java') > 0, 'Java', countIf(ResourceAttributes['telemetry.sdk.language'] = 'go') > 0, 'Go', '' ), '') AS tech FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) GROUP BY ServiceName ) AS tech ON stats.name = tech.name

SELECT caller_service AS caller, callee_service AS callee, toUInt64(sum(call_count)) AS callCount, toUInt64(sum(error_count)) AS errorCount, sum(error_count) / sum(call_count) AS errorRate, avg(duration_avg) AS avgDurationNs, groupUniqArray(span_name) AS operations, '' AS calleeType, '' AS calleeTech FROM quasar_tracing.service_dependency WHERE time_bucket BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) GROUP BY caller, callee UNION ALL SELECT caller, callee, toUInt64(count()) AS callCount, toUInt64(countIf(statusCode = 'Error')) AS errorCount, countIf(statusCode = 'Error') / count() AS errorRate, avg(durationNs) AS avgDurationNs, groupUniqArray(spanName) AS operations, calleeType, calleeTech FROM ( SELECT caller, spanName, statusCode, durationNs, calleeType, calleeTech, concat( calleeTech, if(targetNamespace = '', '', concat(' · ', targetNamespace)), ' · ', targetAddress, if(targetPort = '', '', concat(':', targetPort)) ) AS callee FROM ( SELECT caller, spanName, statusCode, durationNs, if(dbSystem != '', 'datastore', 'mq') AS calleeType, substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(multiIf( dbSystem = 'postgresql', 'PostgreSQL', dbSystem = 'mysql', 'MySQL', dbSystem = 'mongodb', 'MongoDB', dbSystem = 'redis', 'Redis', dbSystem = 'elasticsearch', 'Elasticsearch', dbSystem = 'clickhouse', 'ClickHouse', dbSystem != '', dbSystem, messagingSystem = 'kafka', 'Kafka', messagingSystem = 'rabbitmq', 'RabbitMQ', messagingSystem = 'rocketmq', 'RocketMQ', messagingSystem ), '[^0-9A-Za-z._:-]', '_'), 1, 32) AS calleeTech, substringUTF8( replaceRegexpAll(targetNamespaceRaw, '[^0-9A-Za-z._:-]', '_'), 1, 96 ) AS targetNamespace, substringUTF8( replaceRegexpAll(lowerUTF8(targetAddressRaw), '[^0-9A-Za-z._:-]', '_'), 1, 96 ) AS targetAddress, substringUTF8(replaceRegexpAll(targetPortRaw, '[^0-9]', ''), 1, 5) AS targetPort FROM ( SELECT ServiceName AS caller, SpanName AS spanName, StatusCode AS statusCode, Duration AS durationNs, lowerUTF8(coalesce( nullIf(SpanAttributes['db.system.name'], ''), nullIf(SpanAttributes['db.system'], ''), '' )) AS dbSystem, lowerUTF8(SpanAttributes['messaging.system']) AS messagingSystem, if( coalesce( nullIf(SpanAttributes['db.system.name'], ''), nullIf(SpanAttributes['db.system'], ''), '' ) != '', coalesce( nullIf(SpanAttributes['db.namespace'], ''), nullIf(SpanAttributes['db.name'], ''), '' ), coalesce( nullIf(SpanAttributes['messaging.destination.name'], ''), nullIf(SpanAttributes['messaging.destination'], ''), '' ) ) AS targetNamespaceRaw, coalesce( nullIf(SpanAttributes['server.address'], ''), nullIf(SpanAttributes['net.peer.name'], ''), nullIf(SpanAttributes['net.peer.ip'], ''), '' ) AS targetAddressRaw, coalesce( nullIf(SpanAttributes['server.port'], ''), nullIf(SpanAttributes['net.peer.port'], ''), '' ) AS targetPortRaw FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) AND SpanKind = 'Client' ) WHERE (dbSystem != '' OR messagingSystem != '') AND targetAddressRaw != '' ) ) GROUP BY caller, callee, calleeType, calleeTech
